cases.label: Quiet bedside review
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: Static sampled-frame packet should stay reviewable rather than fail outright.

cases.label: Prop swap revision
cases.prompt_text: A table scene cuts between matching framings, but the folder on the tabletop changes from red to blue after the cut.
cases.expectation_note: Continuity-breaking prop swap should be treated as blocking.

cases.label: Missing file revision
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: Missing media file is a blocking runtime failure.

cases.label: Corrupt decode revision
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: Corrupt media that cannot decode is a blocking runtime failure.
